statement: One unchanged fresh movielens-lagrange-service-affinity-live run reports priority metric 0; every JOINING node, including READY with fresh liveness, remains absent from generic serving, locally eligible, published-active, required-ack, and remove-safety membership, while an explicitly recovery-eligible reachable JOINING node can receive only priority control-plane formation placement until activation.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.

A JOINING node must remain absent from generic projected-serving, locally eligible, published-active, required-ack, and remove-safety membership even when its connection is READY and its liveness evidence is fresh.

Pre-active placement may admit only a canonical JOINING node with explicit controlPlaneRecoveryEligible evidence, connected live transport, startup-authority membership, and a priority control-plane partition; it must fail closed when any conjunct is withdrawn.

Before a live run, prove registration through real readiness, membership-candidate derivation, startup authority, and UnifiedRebalancer placement in one deterministic path, including JOINING plus READY/fresh negative isolation and red-on-revert behavior.
Do not raise any timeout or budget and do not add a cache, table, retry loop, parallel membership owner, or generic active-projection bypass.
